convention: Frame axes: x forward, y left, z up, origin on the ground at the hull's middle. half_extents_m is the hull box (z: half the roof height). pivot_m is the turret ring centre; muzzle_m is from the pivot (turret frame). Measured stations are in the same axes.

thresholds.hull_dimension: fix when off by more than max(0.10 m, 3 %)
thresholds.pivot_x: fix when off by more than 0.15 m
thresholds.pivot_z_and_muzzle: same as a hull dimension: max(0.10 m, 3 % of the value)

drawings.shows: Challenger 2 TES, both sides, top, front, rear (shaded)
drawings.licence: copyrighted (the-blueprints.com); measured in throwaway/, not committed
drawings.scale_from: gun forward 11.55 m over muzzle..rear plate: side 620 px (53.7), top 600 px (51.9); front 51.7 from the 4.2 m TES width. The hull then measures 8.38 m (published 8.3)

published.source: en.wikipedia.org Challenger 2 (8.3 hull, 3.5 / 4.2 with appliqué, 2.49 high); gun forward 11.55 m (army-technology). Wikipedia's 13.5 m gun forward is rejected: the L30A1 barrel is 6.6 m and the drawing agrees with 11.55

verdicts.why: the drawing's 2.3 m is trusted less than the published figure; its other heights run 5 % low

verdicts.source: cr2 top: the cupola sits at -0.42 m, behind the ring as on every turret; low confidence
drawing side and top, and 11.55 - 8.3 published
verdicts.why: the frame's gun is 1.5 m short: the model reaches 10.0 m gun forward against 11.55

notes.why: the real turret's front reaches about +3.0 m, 0.9-1.2 m behind the nose; the model's stops at +1.98 m. The turret box is about 5.0 m long against the model's 4.2 m, with long flat sides and steep front faces. The short gun (fix row) makes the turret look stubby too

published.source: Calibre Defence, Challenger 3 technical profile (2026): 11.3 m gun forward, 4.2 m wide with armour, over 3 m to the sight; the hull is the Challenger 2's

frame.note: inherits the Challenger 2 TES frame; its cannon row overrides only weapons

measured.muzzle_from_pivot_m: 6.95: 11.3 - 8.3 = 3.0 past the front (4.15 + 3.0 - 0.2); the L55A1's 6.6 m tube is the L30A1's length

verdicts.why: the Challenger 3 inherits the Challenger 2's muzzle; it needs its own, 0.15 m shorter than the Challenger 2's fixed one

notes.why: the hull matches the Challenger 2's; the new turret has no drawing or licensable photo (only the generated references), so its shape is the art's call. The short gun, as on the Challenger 2, is the frame row
